description: Defines an enum RequirementSeverity for representing severity levels of requirements, including methods for retrieving severity titles, statuses, and determining the most severe requirement from a list.

classes.name: RequirementSeverity
classes.description: An enum representing severity levels for requirements, with methods for handling severity logic.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the translated title of the severity.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the string status of the severity.

methods.name: maxSeverityFromRequirements
methods.description: Determines the most severe requirement from a list.

methods.name: convertLegacyIntSeveritiesToEnums
methods.description: Converts legacy integer severity values to enum instances.
